members.instructions: What is the customer's intent? Pick the single option that best matches what the customer is asking about.
members.state_template:
Customer message to a digital bank's support chat:
{{input}}

criteria.activate_card_how: How to activate a newly received card, or the card will not activate
criteria.card_not_arrived: Ordered card has not arrived yet / is late / customer wants to track the card being mailed
criteria.card_delivery_time: Asks in advance how long card delivery takes, when a card will come, or whether it can arrive by a date / be expedited
criteria.link_card_to_app: Link or add a card to the app / account (e.g. make a newly received card show in the app, re-link a card)
criteria.order_new_card: How to order or apply for a (new) plastic card, card ordering process, fees or countries for ordering a card
criteria.physical_card_get: Wants to get a physical card (has only virtual or none), or asks where to find the PIN of a newly received card
criteria.spare_card: Extra / additional / spare / second card, ordering another card and its fees, a card for a family member
criteria.virtual_card_get: How to get, order or find a (non-disposable) virtual card
criteria.disposable_card_get: How to get or create a disposable / single-use virtual card, who can have one
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many cards, max amount
criteria.card_expiring: Card is expiring or expired: how to replace it, fees or express delivery for the new card, or getting the replacement card sent/shipped to a particular country (e.g. 'can I get this shipped to China?')
criteria.card_stolen_lost: Card is lost, stolen, missing, or was left somewhere; report or freeze it
criteria.card_compromised: Card details may be compromised / hacked / someone else knows or is using the card details; fraud concern about the card itself
criteria.card_swallowed_atm: ATM kept / ate / swallowed / trapped the card
criteria.phone_lost: Customer's phone was lost, stolen, or left behind; access to the app without the phone
criteria.visa_mc: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing the card network
criteria.apple_google_pay: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Android Pay, Apple Watch, mobile wallets (including topping up via them)
criteria.where_card_accepted: Where the card can be used / is accepted, whether merchants or places accept it
criteria.card_broken: Physical card does not work / is not working anywhere, card is broken or damaged
criteria.virtual_broken: Virtual or disposable virtual card is not working, rejected or declined when paying
criteria.card_payment_declined: A card payment in a shop or online was declined or rejected
criteria.card_payment_pending: A card payment / purchase is still pending, how long pending takes, what pending means
criteria.card_payment_reverted: A card payment went through then was reverted, returned, cancelled, or the money came back
criteria.card_payment_unknown: There is a card payment / purchase or charge on the account the customer does not recognise or did not make (no small odd amount like £1)
criteria.card_payment_fee: Charged a fee for paying with the card / a card purchase, or a general complaint about getting charged fees
criteria.card_payment_fx: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment made abroad / in foreign currency
criteria.charged_twice: Same payment charged twice / duplicate transaction
criteria.extra_unknown_charge: An unexplained extra charge, or a small odd amount (e.g. £1, $1, 1L) on the statement, even if the customer says they do not recognise it
criteria.pin_change: How to change or reset the card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN / card blocked after entering the wrong PIN too many times, unblock
criteria.passcode_forgot: Forgot the app passcode / password / login code
criteria.personal_details: Change name, address, email, phone number or other personal details
criteria.close_account: Close, delete or terminate the account
criteria.age: Minimum age, children or teenagers opening or using an account
criteria.country: Which countries the service / cards are available in, using the account while living in a country
criteria.id_how: How to verify identity, what documents or steps are needed, how long identity verification takes
criteria.id_why: Why identity verification is needed, whether the customer has to verify at all, why so much personal information is asked for
criteria.id_failing: Identity verification is failing, not working, or the app still says not verified
criteria.source_of_funds: Proving or showing where the customer's money comes from (source of funds / wealth)
criteria.atm_where: Where to find ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, using ATMs
criteria.atm_fee: Fee or charge for withdrawing cash at an ATM; also vague complaints like 'why was I charged a fee, I thought it was free'
criteria.atm_wrong_amount: ATM gave less / wrong amount of cash than requested or charged
criteria.atm_declined: Cash withdrawal at the ATM was declined / not authorised
criteria.atm_pending: Cash withdrawal still pending / shown in progress
criteria.atm_unknown: A cash withdrawal on the account the customer did not make
criteria.atm_fx: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
criteria.topup_card_how: Topping up / adding money with a debit or credit card: how to do it, or a problem during a card top-up such as the money going missing
criteria.topup_card_fee: Fee for topping up with a card
criteria.topup_bank_fee: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.topup_cash_cheque: Top up or deposit using cash or a cheque
criteria.topup_auto: Anything about the automatic / auto top-up feature, including its limit or settings
criteria.topup_limits: Limits on top-up amount or number of top-ups (not auto top-up)
criteria.topup_pending: Top-up is still pending, has not completed yet
criteria.topup_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, did not work, or something went wrong with the top-up so the money cannot be used (not about whether a card brand is supported)
criteria.topup_reverted: Top-up appeared then was reverted / disappeared / cancelled, or top-up was made but the account was never credited
criteria.topup_verify: Verification code / verifying a top-up or the card used to top up
criteria.transfer_in_how: How to transfer / move money into this account from another bank account
criteria.receive_money: Receiving money or a salary from others into the account
criteria.transfer_balance_same: Money transferred into the account (e.g. from the customer's UK / other bank account) but it is not showing / balance not updated, even when asked as 'how long does it take'
criteria.deposit_balance_same: Deposited cash or a cheque but the balance has not updated, incl. 'when will my deposit show up?'
criteria.transfer_how_long: How long transfers take to arrive, how much longer to wait for a transfer
criteria.transfer_pending: The customer's transaction is shown as pending / in progress: when will the transaction post or be complete
criteria.transfer_recipient_missing: Sent a transfer (to a person, landlord, retailer, payee) and it has not arrived yet, e.g. 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet'
criteria.transfer_declined: Transfer was declined / rejected / not allowed
criteria.transfer_failed: Transfer failed or did not go through
criteria.transfer_cancel: Cancel or reverse a transfer that was made
criteria.transfer_fee: Charged a fee for a transfer, or a higher fee for banking / sending money abroad
criteria.beneficiary: Cannot add a beneficiary / payee, or trying to transfer to a particular account and not being allowed / unable to
criteria.refund_request: Wants to get a refund for a purchase, how to request one
criteria.refund_missing: A refund was expected but has not shown up in the account
criteria.fx_rate: What exchange rate is used / where to see rates
criteria.fx_fee: Fee or charge for exchanging currency
criteria.fx_in_app: The mechanics of doing a currency exchange in the app (where / how in the app)
criteria.fiat: Which currencies are supported: can be held in the account or exchanged to/from (e.g. 'can you exchange to EUR?')
criteria.cards_currencies: Which cards, payment methods and currencies are accepted (e.g. what can I use to add funds, which cards can top up, why a card brand like American Express does not work)

members.name: two_level
members.state_template:
Customer message to a digital bank's support chat:
{{input}}

router.instructions: Which area of banking is the customer asking about?

criteria.card_getting: Getting, ordering, receiving, activating, linking, replacing or choosing a card (physical, virtual, disposable, spare)
criteria.card_problems: A card that is lost, stolen, compromised, swallowed, not working, or declining
criteria.card_payments: Card purchases/payments or charges on the statement: pending, reverted, unrecognised, fees, exchange rate, duplicate, refunds
criteria.top_up: Topping up / adding money to the account
criteria.transfers: Bank transfers in or out, beneficiaries, receiving money

card_getting.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.card_arrival: card has not arrived / tracking it
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery will take
criteria.card_linking: linking or adding a card in the app
criteria.order_physical_card: ordering a card, what getting one's own card costs
criteria.get_physical_card: getting a physical card, can't find the card's PIN
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting another / additional card, fees for it
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring, replacement, express fees or shipping the new card to another country

card_problems.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.compromised_card: card details compromised, no specific unknown withdrawal
criteria.card_not_working: card not working at all / at several places / broken
criteria.declined_card_payment: card payment declined, card did not work at a shop

card_payments.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: unrecognised or unknown charge or payment
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: fee / charged extra for using the card, fed up with being charged fees
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate on a card payment
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: charged extra / a small odd amount like 1 pound or dollar, even unrecognised

cash.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.atm_support: finding ATMs or which ATMs accept the card
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: ATM withdrawal fee, 'charged a fee but thought it was free'
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: withdrawal declined, ATM would not work / give cash
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: someone withdrew cash the customer did not (even if they ask to freeze the card)

top_up.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.topping_up_by_card: top up or transfer money in using a credit/debit card, including money vanishing during a card top-up
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: top up with cash or cheque
criteria.pending_top_up: top-up pending, can't see the funds yet after topping up
criteria.top_up_failed: top-up failed or went wrong so the money can't be accessed (not via Apple Pay / Google Pay)
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: topping up via Apple Pay / Google Pay, or it not working
criteria.top_up_reverted: top-up reverted, or topped up but account not credited
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards/currencies accepted, e.g. American Express not working for adding money
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: cash/cheque deposit not in balance, when will my deposit show up

transfers.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.transfer_into_account: moving money in from another bank account (not with a card)
criteria.transfer_timing: how long transfers take in general
criteria.pending_transfer: a transfer/transaction made is still pending, not complete, not posted yet
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: sent transfer hasn't reached the payee/retailer/person yet, or the customer worries it is overdue; 'I transferred money but it is not there yet'
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: beneficiary not allowed, can't transfer to a given account

currency.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: rate complaint about cash taken out
criteria.exchange_charge: exchange fees, costs, discounts for exchanging often

account.instructions: What exactly does the customer want?

criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot the app passcode (not the card PIN)
criteria.country_support: supported countries, can I get a card if I live in X

instructions.task: Label the support message with its intent.
rules: Pick the intent about the customer's main request.
Prefer the most specific intent that fits.
